content.short: Orca is a Solana-based DEX with SPL token trading and incentivized pools.
content.description: Orca is a decentralized exchange deployed on Solana with a simple, beginner-friendly interface designed for fast, straightforward trading. Users can swap SPL tokens with minimal slippage and near-instant finality, thanks to Solana's architecture. The platform offers incentivized liquidity pools that reward liquidity providers with emissions, delivering yield for those who supply liquidity. By adding SOL or stSOL to a pool, users can earn passive income from trading fees while helping guard against impermanent loss.
